# KIT Brücke

`Modellbahnbruecke-LoD2-V03__v3.gml` is the LoD2 version of the [KIT Brücke](https://www.citygmlwiki.org/index.php?title=KIT_Br%C3%BCcke)
(`Modellbahnbruecke-LoD2-V03.zip`), a fictional bridge at Bundesstrasse 36 near KIT Campus North, made by the
Institute for Automation and Applied Computer Science (IAI) at the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT) with
SketchUp and 3DIS CityEditor. Its CityGML 2.0 file was upgraded to CityGML 3.0 using
[citygml-tools](https://github.com/citygml4j/citygml-tools); the textures are not included. It has a bridge with
11 bridge constructive elements, 2 bridge installations and an appearance.

Attribution: Institute for Automation and Applied Computer Science (IAI) / Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT).
